by
  intro n hn h5
  have hle : n ≤ 59 := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hn (by decide)
  have : 2 ^ n > n ^ 2 := by
    -- By induction on n from 5 to 59
    have base : 2 ^ 5 > 5 ^ 2 := by decide
    have step : ∀ k, 5 ≤ k → k ≤ 58 → 2 ^ k > k ^ 2 → 2 ^ (k + 1) > (k + 1) ^ 2 := by
      intro k hk5 hkle hlt
      calc
        2 ^ (k + 1) = 2 * 2 ^ k := by rw [Nat.pow_succ]
        _ > 2 * k ^ 2 := by
          have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hlt (by decide : (0 : Nat) < 2)
          simpa using this
        _ ≥ (k + 1) ^ 2 := by
          have : k ^ 2 - 2 * k - 1 ≥ 0 := by
            have : (k - 1) ^ 2 ≥ 0 := by exact pow_two_nonneg _
            linarith
          linarith
    -- Now apply induction over the range 5..n
    have : 5 ≤ n := h5
    have : ∀ m, 5 ≤ m → m ≤ n → 2 ^ m > m ^ 2 := by
      intro m hm hmlt
      have : m = 5 ∨ 5 < m := by omega
      cases this with
      | inl h => simpa [h] using base
      | inr hlt =>
        have hprev : 5 ≤ m - 1 ∧ m - 1 ≤ 58 := by
          have : m - 1 < 59 := by omega
          exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
        have hprevineq := this (m - 1) hprev.1 hprev.2
        have : 2 ^ m > m ^ 2 := step (m - 1) hprev.1 hprev.2 hprevineq
        simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_comm] using this
    exact this n h5 hle
  simpa [Nat.pow_two, Nat.mul_comm] using this
